scenario_1_kill9.break: Disable WAL (journal_mode=DELETE) — child writes without WAL, SIGKILL mid-burst
scenario_1_kill9.red: integrity_check may return rows other than 'ok' (partial page written to main file without WAL replay)
scenario_1_kill9.encoding: it.skip '[NC] negative control: without WAL, integrity_check may fail after SIGKILL' — change it.skip to it to activate
scenario_1_kill9.restore: Re-enable WAL in child script (useWal=true) to restore green

scenario_2_diskfull.break: Remove max_page_count constraint — large write succeeds instead of failing
scenario_2_diskfull.encoding: it.skip '[NC] negative control: without max_page_count, write succeeds (E_IO guard removed)' — asserts caught===null

scenario_3_overflow.break: Set maxSize=Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER — no overflow guard fires
scenario_3_overflow.encoding: it.skip '[NC] negative control: without overflow guard (maxSize=MAX), all writes succeed' — asserts rejections.length===0

pre_existing_flake.test: batch of 10 items with 1 byte-duplicate returns 9 ok + 1 E_DEDUP with existing_uid
pre_existing_flake.cause: fastembed warmup timeout (30000ms limit) under concurrent test load. Not caused by HF-1 changes. Appeared on 1 of 5 gate runs.
pre_existing_flake.evidence: Test is in write.spec.ts (unmodified by S1). The chaos specs (3 new files) never failed across all runs.

notes: Scenario 1: child worker spawned as .cjs (avoids ESM module resolution in tmpdir), uses project-resolved require() paths for better-sqlite3 + sqlite-vec
Scenario 2: max_page_count set to currentPageCount+2 (≈8KB headroom); 100 rows×4KB each forces SQLITE_FULL → wrapDbError maps to E_IO
Scenario 3: maxSize=5, slow anchor holds queue; flood of 15 items causes >5 queue rejections with E_BUSY shape (retryable:true, retry_after_ms:250)
All chaos stores use OS tmpdir (mkdtemp), NOT ~/.memory
Cleanup: afterEach removes tmpdir + calls _resetAllLeasesForTest() + WriteQueue.clearInstances()

items.title: Soak + SLO threshold gates with degraded-run control

commands.summary: All soak/ files pass linting (zero errors from soak-runner.ts, metrics-exporter.ts, soak.spec.ts). 22 pre-existing @nx/enforce-module-boundaries circular-dep errors in cluster.ts, embed.ts, recall.ts, etc. (not caused by S2 — none are in soak/). Pre-existing: confirmed by git diff --name-only HEAD showing only soak/ files.
Run 1: 20 test files passed (1 skipped), 253 tests passed (5 skipped). Duration 41.13s. +13 new soak tests vs HF-1 baseline of 240.
Run 2: 20 test files passed (1 skipped), 253 tests passed (5 skipped). Duration 40.64s.
Run 3: 20 test files passed (1 skipped), 253 tests passed (5 skipped). Duration 68.91s.

negative_control.break: Remove injected delay (injectedDelayMs=0) — no latency inflation → tight budget (max_write_p50_ms=10ms) passes
negative_control.red: B2 assertion expect(result.passed).toBe(false) would fail if injection removed — tight budget would pass
negative_control.encoding: it.skip '[NC] negative control: without injection, tight budget passes (injection is load-bearing)' — change it.skip to it to activate
negative_control.restore: Re-add injectedDelayMs=50 to the degraded run call

gate_has_teeth_control.mechanism: runSoak() called with injectedDelayMs=50 → every queue slot sleeps 50ms → write_p50_ms >= 50ms
gate_has_teeth_control.verdict: compareToBudget() returns passed=false with write_p50_ms violation (actual >= 50ms >> budget 10ms)
gate_has_teeth_control.test: Suite B / B2: 'degraded run FAILS a tight sample budget (gate has teeth)'

notes: Scope fence: libs/memory-core/src/soak/ only — no edits to chaos/, recall.ts, or lifecycle modules
Thresholds NOT hardcoded — BudgetParams is passed in by caller; integrator selects production values from _shared/baselines/write-perf.json
SOX_SOAK_INJECT_TXN_DELAY_MS env flag activates degraded run (resolveInjectedDelay() reads it; tests override via injectedDelayMs option)
CI profile: 8 writers × 30 ops = 240 total ops (fast); SOX_SOAK_LONG=1 runs full 16×100 profile
Metrics JSON shape: _schema:1, _shard:'HF-2', latency_ms{p50,p99,mean,min,max}, lock_wait_ms, txn_duration_ms, queue_depth, wal{checkpoint_age_ms,bytes_final}
compareToBudget() reads _shared/baselines/write-perf.json and reports baseline_p50_ms/baseline_p99_ms in the result
Pre-existing lint issue (22 circular dep errors in memory-core pre-S2 files): recorded in discovered[]

evidence.summary: ADR-0007 ACCEPTED; S8-S11 merged + live-verified; BL sweep (BL-157/162/164/165/170/172-175/177/179/183/185/186/188-192 resolved; BL-201/202/203 filed); versions aligned (memory-core 0.3.0, memory-server 1.3.0); two-phase memory_update live-verified; final smoke 13/0 hermetic; REPORT.md complete.

blockers.note: os-unit generator runs the serve_mode:proxy memory-server as direct-stdio (no port listener) → launchd daemon unreachable. HF-5 writer-count forensics must distinguish the per-session soxe-serve process from the launchd daemon by owner (session vs os-unit) and confirm only one holds the writer lease. Fix is spec-governed (docs/spec/service-lifecycle.md §9).

All are memory-core -> sox-ecosystem -> memory-core via scripts/capture-enrichment-baseline.mjs and scripts/capture-write-perf-baseline.mjs. None are in the soak/ files created by S2. Integrator should address the circular dep in the baseline capture scripts (they import memory-core from the repo root project). Out of S2 scope fence.
